subject: Cannot log in after password change
description: User says login fails after changing password; locked out of the account.
resolution: Reset the password and cleared cache; confirmed login works.

subject: SSO login loop
description: Authentication redirects back to the login page; SSO and MFA prompt never completes.
resolution: Reset MFA credentials and updated the SSO configuration settings.

subject: Locked out of workspace
description: Several staff are locked out; access denied after permission change.
resolution: Reset the password for the admin and restored permission group.

subject: 2FA codes rejected
description: Authentication codes are rejected, cannot log in from new phone.
resolution: Reset 2FA and verified login.

subject: Dashboard is very slow
description: Dashboard loading is slow with high latency; pages timed out during peak.
resolution: Restarted the reporting service and cleared the cache; latency back to normal.

subject: Export times out
description: CSV export times out and the page hangs; performance is poor.
resolution: Applied a hotfix to the export job and restarted the worker.

subject: App lag on large projects
description: Severe lag and slow loading when opening large projects.
resolution: Escalated to engineering; patch released that fixed the query performance.

subject: Charged twice for subscription
description: Customer was charged twice; billing shows duplicate invoice and payment.
resolution: Issued a refund for the duplicate charge and credited the next invoice.

subject: Invoice shows wrong VAT
description: Invoice has wrong tax on billing statement; payment blocked.
resolution: Corrected the invoice and issued a credit note.

subject: Refund not received
description: Refund for cancelled subscription never arrived; payment still pending.
resolution: Re-issued the refund through the payment provider.

subject: Credit card declined on renewal
description: Credit card payment declined at subscription renewal; billing page errors.
resolution: Updated payment method and retried the charge; refund of late fee issued.

subject: Contacts missing after import
description: CSV import dropped rows; missing data and duplicate contacts after migration.
resolution: Re-synced the data from the source file and removed duplicates.

subject: Calendar sync stuck
description: Sync has stopped; data not updating between calendar and app.
resolution: Re-synced the account and restarted the sync worker.

subject: Duplicate records after migration
description: Migration created duplicate records, sync conflicts everywhere.
resolution: Rolled back the migration and re-ran the import with dedupe enabled.

subject: App crashes on startup
description: Application crash on launch with an error and blank screen.
resolution: Reinstalled the application and cleared the cache; crash no longer reproduces.

subject: 500 error saving report
description: Saving a report returns a 500 error with a stack trace.
resolution: Rolled back the latest release and applied a hotfix.

subject: Editor freezes
description: The editor freezes then shows an error exception.
resolution: Applied a patch and asked customer to reinstall the desktop client.

subject: Web app blank screen
description: Blank screen after login, console shows exception and error.
resolution: Cleared cache and restarted the web service.

subject: Webhook not firing
description: Webhook integration stopped delivering events; API returns errors.
resolution: Regenerated the API token and updated the webhook configuration.

subject: API rate limit hit
description: Customer integration gets rate limit responses from the API.
resolution: Raised the rate limit and rotated the API key.

subject: OAuth token expired for integration
description: OAuth integration fails; token expired and API calls are rejected.
resolution: Regenerated the token and allow-listed the callback domain.

subject: Need help with initial setup
description: New customer needs to configure settings and finish onboarding setup.
resolution: Updated the configuration settings and walked through setup.

subject: Install fails on managed laptops
description: Install is blocked by company policy; configuration of the environment needed.
resolution: Updated settings and allow-listed the installer; install succeeded.

subject: Not receiving email notifications
description: Notification emails are not receiving; likely spam folder.
resolution: Allow-listed the sender domain and re-enabled notification settings.

subject: SMS alerts delayed
description: SMS notification arrive hours late; notify rules misfire.
resolution: Restarted the notification service and updated the configuration.

subject: Weekly digest email missing
description: Customer not receiving the weekly digest email.
resolution: Updated the notification settings and allow-listed the domain.

subject: Things feel off since Tuesday
description: Customer says something is different and not working like before.
resolution: Escalated to engineering; they rolled back a feature flag.

subject: Strange behaviour with shared board
description: The shared board behaves oddly for one team only.
resolution: Restarted the service after reviewing the logs.

subject: Login slow and then error
description: Login is slow and then shows an error; authentication timed out.
resolution: Restarted the auth service and cleared the cache.

subject: Billing page crash
description: Billing page crash with an error after payment update.
resolution: Applied a patch and issued a refund for the failed charge.
